help.admin_body:
• Danger Zone — Reset all data, force admin password reset, set log retention, and view audit logs.
  • Settings — Toggle dark mode, view system info (Python version, database path, hostname).
  • Setup script — Run sudo ./setup_hub.sh to provision the hotspot, install dependencies, and configure the systemd service from scratch.
help.getting_started_body:
• Connect — Join the EduMesh Wi-Fi hotspot broadcast by the Hub laptop. The captive portal opens automatically.
  • Install the app — On the welcome page, download the EduMesh APK and install it on your Android phone. Enable "Install from Unknown Sources" if prompted.
  • Register — Open the app, enter your name, and you are in. The Hub assigns you a permanent student ID.
  • Start learning — Browse textbooks, videos, and other resources. Download them to use offline.
help.subtitle: How to use the Lumina Hub and EduMesh app.
help.teachers_body:
• Upload resources — Go to Content Manager, select a PDF or video, give it a title and subject, and click Upload. Resources are available to all students immediately.
  • Manage content — Filter by subject and grade to find resources. Click delete to remove any resource and its file.
  • View students — Go to Students to see all registered students, filter by grade, or search by name. Each card shows weekly study time, streak, and saved resources.
  • Detailed analytics — Click a student to see their full profile with study time breakdown and resource count.
  • Change your password — Go to Account Settings to update your login credentials, display name, and department.
help.title: Help & Instructions
help.tracking_body:
• Study time — The app tracks focused study sessions using the built-in timer. Total weekly minutes are synced to the Hub.
  • Streak — Consecutive days the student uses the app. Calculated on the phone and synced to the Hub.
  • Saved resources — Each time a student bookmarks or downloads a resource, the count is updated.
  • Privacy — Individual events (which PDF was opened, what was searched) stay on the student's phone and are never sent to the Hub.
help.troubleshooting_body:
• App cannot connect — Ensure your phone is on the EduMesh Wi-Fi and the Hub laptop is powered on. Restart the app and wait a few seconds.
  • Forgot your password — Plug a keyboard into the Hub laptop and run sudo ./reset_admin.sh in a terminal. This resets the admin password to lumina2026.
  • App is slow — Close other apps, restart EduMesh, or clear app data from Android Settings and reinstall.
  • Hub storage is full — Delete unused resources from Content Manager. Check disk usage on the Home page. For advanced cleanup, run sudo ./setup_hub.sh.

welcome.guide.download_offline_body: Tap the download icon on any resource to save it to your phone. Downloaded resources work even when you’re not connected to the EduMesh network. Perfect for studying anywhere.
welcome.guide.for_teachers_body: Teachers can log in above using their credentials. Once logged in, you can upload resources, view student analytics, manage grades and subjects, and configure the hub — including changing passwords and managing storage. Visit the Teacher Guide in the sidebar after logging in for detailed instructions.
welcome.guide.getting_started_body:
• Connect to Wi-Fi — Turn on your phone’s Wi-Fi and join the network named EduMesh. No password needed.
  • Open the welcome page — Once connected, a login screen should appear automatically (captive portal). If not, open your browser and go to http://lumina.hub:8000.
  • Download the app — Tap the Download App button in the top-right corner of this page to get the EduMesh APK.
  • Install the app — Open the downloaded file and tap Install. If your phone asks, allow “Install from Unknown Sources” in Settings.
  • Register — Open the EduMesh app, enter your name, and you’re in. You’ll be assigned a permanent student ID.
  • Start learning — Browse textbooks, videos, past papers, and more. Tap any resource to view it, or download it to access offline.
welcome.guide.tracking_privacy_body:
The app tracks your study time using a built-in timer and counts your daily streak of consecutive study days. This helps teachers see how the class is engaging with materials.

Your privacy matters. Individual details — like which PDF you opened or what you searched for — stay on your phone and are never sent to the Hub. Only your total weekly minutes, streak days, and resource count are shared.
welcome.guide.troubleshooting_body:
• Can’t connect to Wi-Fi? Make sure the Hub laptop is powered on and broadcasting. Ask your teacher to check.
  • Captive portal not opening? Open your browser and manually go to http://lumina.hub:8000.
  • App won’t install? Go to Settings > Security and enable “Install from Unknown Sources”. Then try again.
  • App is slow or crashing? Close other apps, restart EduMesh, or clear app data from Android Settings and reinstall.
welcome.guide.using_app_body:
The EduMesh app has four tabs at the bottom:

  • Dashboard — See your study stats, recent activity, and quick-access resources.
  • Browse — Explore all available resources by subject or grade. Search by keyword.
  • Saved — View resources you’ve bookmarked or downloaded for offline use.
  • Profile — View your weekly study time, streak, and saved resource count.
